question: Should 0.38.4 land through this combined release branch, or should the shared Homebrew fix land through https://github.com/openclaw/crabbox/pull/1090 with release metadata recreated afterward?
rationale: Both open PRs contain commit 9497eb20f4a70051dc9a382650f2c3a5a53e38e5, and release serialization is an ownership decision rather than a code defect automation can resolve.

options.title: Land the combined release branch
options.body: Merge this PR as the authoritative 0.38.4 path and close the narrower PR after the shared fix is on main.

options.title: Land the narrow fix first
options.body: Merge https://github.com/openclaw/crabbox/pull/1090, close this PR, and recreate the 0.38.4 metadata from updated main.

recommendation.title: Land the combined release branch
recommendation.body: Merge this PR as the authoritative 0.38.4 path and close the narrower PR after the shared fix is on main.

likelyOwner.reason: The prior release tag and both overlapping branch commits make steipete the best available owner for the release-sequencing choice.
